args.doc: No mutable access to the component.
Storage type: Table (default, fast iteration) or SparseSet (frequent insert/remove).
Hook that runs when the component is added; bare `on_add` uses Self::on_add.
Hook that runs when the component is inserted.
Hook that runs when the component is discarded.
Hook that runs when the component is removed.
Hook that runs when the entity is despawned.
How the component is cloned (a ComponentCloneBehavior variant such as Ignore).
Track a summary tick so contiguous queries can skip unchanged tables (Table storage only).
Use the component's MapEntities implementation (or a function: map_entities = path) to remap entities.

attributes.name: require
attributes.doc: Components inserted automatically with this one: #[require(B, C)], with values #[require(B(1))] or an initializer #[require(C = init_c())].

attributes.name: entities
attributes.doc: Marks a field that contains entities so they are remapped automatically (scenes, cloning).
